planets.name: TOI-4495 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4495 with a 5.18-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-4495 c was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-4495. Its orbit and size follow Wang et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
